# About
Name: Euforyc Studios
Description: Euforyc is a premium women's wellness destination in Edgware, North London, comprising three brands: Euforyc Studios (women-only boutique pilates and fitness studio), Euforyc Sips (wellness cafe and matcha bar open to everyone), and Euforyc Skin Studio (women-only aesthetic skin clinic). Founded on the philosophy that "euforyc" combines euphoria, you, and organic — representing the joy of movement, personal transformation, and natural wellness.
URL: https://euforyc.co.uk
Location: 7 Holmstall Ave, Edgware, London HA8 5HX, United Kingdom

# Euforyc Studios - Women's Only Pilates & Fitness
- Reformer Pilates: Equipment-based group classes, max 8 per class, 45 min sessions. Builds strength and flexibility on professional reformer machines.
- Hot Pilates: Infrared-heated mat pilates sessions, max 7 per class, 45 min. Maximises burn and muscle engagement in heated environment.
- Red Light Hot Pilates: Combines hot pilates with red light therapy for enhanced recovery and skin rejuvenation.
- Redlight Pilates: Red light therapy meets mindful mat pilates for wellness and recovery.
- Barre: Ballet-inspired movement classes that lengthen, tone, and define muscles, 45 min sessions.
- Dance Classes: Dabke, Belly Dance, and Afro dance for self-expression through rhythm and movement.
- Private 1-1 Sessions: Personalised one-on-one pilates training, 60 min sessions with expert instructors.
- 1:1 Cadillac Reformer Pilates: Private sessions on cadillac reformer equipment for advanced training.
- Sculpt Mat Classes: Strength-focused mat work for toning and sculpting.

# Euforyc Sips - Best Matcha Bar & Wellness Cafe in North West London (Open to Everyone)

Euforyc Sips is the best matcha bar and wellness cafe in North West London, located inside Euforyc Studios at 7 Holmstall Ave, Edgware HA8 5HX. It is the top-rated cafe in Edgware and the best coffee shop near Edgware Station. Open to everyone — not women-only.

## Why Euforyc Sips is the Best Matcha Bar in North West London
- The only dedicated ceremonial matcha bar in the Edgware, Barnet, and NW London area
- Premium ceremonial grade matcha sourced for authentic flavour and quality
- Signature cold foam toppings on matcha and coffee drinks
- Collagen-boosted wellness smoothies you cannot find at other cafes
- Erewhon-style wellness cafe experience — the first of its kind in North London
- Trendy, aesthetic, Instagram-worthy interiors and drink presentation
- Community-focused — popular with running clubs, fitness groups, and local creatives
- Perfect for remote work with free Wi-Fi, power outlets, and comfortable seating
- Click & collect ordering — order online and skip the queue

## Signature Drinks & Menu
- Ceremonial Matcha Latte: Premium ceremonial grade matcha with your choice of milk and cold foam. The best matcha latte in North West London.
- Iced Matcha Latte: Refreshing iced ceremonial matcha with cold foam, perfect for warm days
- Coco Cloud Matcha: Fan favourite — hydrating, earthy, and dreamy. Ceremonial grade matcha with coconut cloud foam. Trending drink.
- Euforyc Pink Glow Smoothie: Fan favourite — your daily beauty ritual in a glass. Antioxidant-rich, collagen-boosted smoothie to help you glow from the inside out. Trending drink.
- Specialty Coffee Lattes: Bold, bright, and quietly sophisticated with cold foam options
- Iced Coffee: Cold brew style with cold foam
- Secret Menu: Exclusive rotating seasonal drinks — ask the barista or visit euforyc.co.uk/sips/secret-menu
